item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders to check your perspective: Is this moment supporting the life you want? Are you projecting or mind reading? Those are good questions, but they only work if you answer them honestly. Noticing a negative pattern is not the same as breaking it. When one shows up today, name it, then choose a different response on purpose. Your action: at midday, pause, ask that question, and write down your answer.
